text: “Batman V Superman: Dawn of Justice” is 10 years old today. So I wish “BVS” a happy 10-year anniversary thankful for the movies it led to. Happy birthday to it.

text: Something i love about “Contact” is how it takes Jodie Foster’s Ellie Arroway, a scientist and skeptic who doesn’t understand people who believe in God based on their faith despite any tangible proof of his existence, and climaxes with her pleading with another skeptic to believe in something else extraordinary despite her having no tangible proof that what she experienced was real. The film’s ambiguousness about what really happened is a strength, but I like how it puts her in the very scenario she’s been scoffing at over the story and, to me at least, leads her to truly understand what it’s like being in the opposite end of the argument.
